title: The Best Goal Tracking App
body:
Love it. Been using this app for a couple of years. Simple, yet super complete. 
The Only thing is that I would suggest to use some colors to categorize tags/goal types, and show better graphics or more detailed graphics of progress tendency. Everything else is great.

title: Amazing app and great customer service!
body: I downloaded the application, but was having trouble syncing the app with my iPhone iCloud account. The customer support team was impressively fast, kind, patient, and helped me through solving this issue. It turns out that I didn't have iCloud Drive activated, and it worked perfectly after following all the steps provided by the support team, the app is amazing, and it has helped me a lot in building good habits and breaking bad ones. I installed after reading "Atomic Habits" by James Clear.
